organic.title: Retrieval-augmented generation for cross-file code search
organic.snippet: RAG over code repositories improves retrieval precision by 22% versus BM25 baselines on cross-file questions.

organic.title: Agentic Coding Benchmarks: A Systematic Evaluation of 12 Systems
organic.snippet: We evaluate 12 agentic coding systems on 1,040 repository-level tasks. The best system completes 41% of tasks end-to-end.

organic.title: Hybrid retrieval outperforms pure vector search for technical corpora
organic.snippet: Hybrid sparse and dense retrieval improves answer accuracy by 14% on enterprise QA benchmarks.

organic.title: Practical guide to building RAG systems
organic.snippet: A short engineering guide to chunking, reranking and evaluating retrieval-augmented generation pipelines.

organic.title: Evaluating RAG pipelines: metrics and pitfalls
organic.snippet: We show that answer-level faithfulness scores correlate poorly with human judgement unless retrieval is also measured.
